instruction: Inspect hard-09_seed.dxf. Launch AutoCAD 2024 from the desktop shortcut, then open `hard-09_seed.dxf`. Create the hard AutoCAD drawing 'crane hook side plate with throat relief' using exact model-space coordinates in millimeters. Create or keep these layers exactly as needed: ANNOTATION, CENTER, CUTOUT, HOLE, OUTLINE, REFERENCE, RIB. Straight geometry may be LINE entities or straight LWPOLYLINE edges; every listed rounded or slot end must be an ARC entity using the listed start/end angles in degrees. Required straight segments: OUTLINE (20,0)->(150,0); OUTLINE (150,0)->(170,35); OUTLINE (170,35)->(145,80); OUTLINE (145,80)->(120,125); OUTLINE (120,125)->(80,145); OUTLINE (80,145)->(45,120); OUTLINE (45,120)->(65,85); OUTLINE (65,85)->(95,70); OUTLINE (95,70)->(100,45); OUTLINE (100,45)->(20,45); OUTLINE (20,45)->(20,0); CENTER (20,22.5)->(150,22.5); CENTER (95,0)->(95,145); RIB (45,120)->(145,80). Required circles: HOLE center (55,25) radius 7; HOLE center (135,25) radius 7; HOLE center (102,108) radius 12; HOLE center (95,55) radius 9. Required arcs: CUTOUT center (120,90) radius 38 start 210 end 330; CUTOUT center (75,70) radius 24 start 35 end 165; OUTLINE center (150,35) radius 20 start 300 end 80. Required text strings: ANNOTATION text ACAD-H09; ANNOTATION text HOOK-PLATE. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
